WITH country_averages AS (
    SELECT
        p.death_country,
        AVG(v.points_won) AS avg_points_won
    FROM player_award_vote AS v
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = v.player_id
    WHERE v.points_won IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY p.death_country
)
SELECT
    death_country,
    avg_points_won,
    avg_points_won - AVG(avg_points_won) OVER () AS distance_from_average
FROM country_averages;

assumptions.assumption: Players with a missing death country are retained as a NULL death_country group; the simple average gives equal weight to each country group, including that group if present.
